bio: Treat yourself to an inventive Afternoon Tea at the Holmes Hotel. This stylish venues provides elegant surroundings to enjoy a unique experience that pays tribute to Britain's most iconic fictional detective.  This unique twist on the great British tradition offers guests a range of indulgent savouries such as a hearty roast beef sandwich and tantalising sweet treats, including a Pistachio Dream and Chocolate Orange Choux.  Set in a vibrant area of London, the Holmes Hotel is located on the iconic Baker Street, just a short walk from Marylebone Railway Station or Baker Street Tube Station.  Please note Holmes Hotel require card details in order to secure your booking. No payment will be taken prior to dining. All bookings must be made up to 48 hours in advance of dining.
